# MemMe

> Local long-term memory for AI pets and companion apps. Rust core, one SQLite file with a VexDB-Lite vector index, offline-first. Owner-global and per-pet relationship memory that survives restarts and model changes.

## Core Concepts

- **AI-pet memory model**: Owner-global memory (stable facts, safety rules — shared across the owner's pets) + per-pet relationship memory (isolated per `agent_id`) + fresh events searchable immediately, before background summarization.
- **Single-file SQLite storage**: One `.db` file holds authoritative data — memories, knowledge graph, FTS index, and change history. Vector search uses the VexDB-Lite persistent `GRAPH_INDEX` SQLite extension (v0.0.17, desktop macOS/Linux x64+arm64); set `MEMME_VEXDB_LITE_EXTENSION` to its absolute path.
- **Pluggable LLM**: Works without an LLM (deterministic vector dedup) or with any LLM (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) for fact extraction.
- **Session/Episode architecture**: Raw events → Sessions → Episodes (LLM purification) → Atomic memory traces → Identity traits.
- **4-channel RRF retrieval**: Vector similarity + BM25 FTS + Entity spreading activation + Temporal search, fused via adaptive Reciprocal Rank Fusion + optional cross-encoder reranking.
- **FSRS forgetting curve**: Power-law memory decay `R(t,S) = (1 + t/(c·S))^(-p)` with stability reinforcement on access. Memories that are never recalled gradually lose relevance.
- **Meditation**: 5-phase consolidation — decay, per-episode fact extraction, LLM reconciliation (ADD/UPDATE/DELETE; deterministic cosine dedup when no LLM is configured), graph extraction, entity linking via Aho-Corasick.

## Workspace Crates (9)

- `memme-core` — Core engine: CRUD, search, graph, dedup, meditation, forgetting curve, backup, export/import, analytics
- `memme-embeddings` — Embedding trait + ONNX/OpenAI/Ollama backends
- `memme-llm` — LLM trait + Ollama/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini backends for fact extraction
- `memme-server` — Self-hosted REST API server (axum) with Bearer auth, backups, OpenAPI
- `memme-mcp` — MCP stdio server for Claude Desktop / Cursor
- `memme-node` — Node.js binding via NAPI-RS — published to npm as `@wjmwjmwb/memme` (macOS/Linux)
- `memme-python` — Python binding via PyO3 + maturin — build from source; PyPI still serves the legacy 0.1.1 build
- `memme-ffi` — Swift/C binding via UniFFI — mobile wiring to the VexDB-Lite runtime pending
- `memme-wasm` — WASM binding — not yet wired to the VexDB-Lite runtime

## Links

- Website: https://vibeinging.github.io/MemMe/
- GitHub: https://github.com/vibeinging/MemMe

## Complete API Signatures

### Construction & Configuration

```rust
// Create a new MemoryStore
pub fn new(config: MemoryConfig, embedder: Arc<dyn Embedder>) -> Result<Self>

// Set LLM provider (builder pattern)
pub fn with_llm(self, llm: Arc<dyn memme_llm::LlmProvider>) -> Self

// Replace LLM provider at runtime
pub fn set_llm_provider(&self, llm: Arc<dyn memme_llm::LlmProvider>)

// Set reranker (builder pattern)
pub fn with_reranker(mut self, reranker: Arc<dyn crate::rerank::Reranker>) -> Self

// Replace reranker at runtime
pub fn set_reranker(&mut self, reranker: Arc<dyn crate::rerank::Reranker>)

// Check whether an LLM provider is configured
pub fn has_llm(&self) -> bool

// Return the embedding dimensions
pub fn embedding_dims(&self) -> usize

// Persist LLM config to DB (for auto-restore on next open)
pub fn save_llm_config(&self, api_key: &str, model: &str, base_url: &str) -> Result<()>

// Read persisted LLM config from DB / env vars
pub fn load_llm_config(&self) -> Option<(String, String, String)>
```

### Core CRUD

```rust
// Add a memory with automatic dedup
pub fn add(&self, content: &str, options: AddOptions) -> Result<MemoryResult>

// Get a single trace by ID (increments access count)
pub fn get_trace(&self, id: &str) -> Result<Option<MemoryResult>>

// Update a trace's content (re-embeds and re-hashes)
pub fn update_trace(&self, id: &str, content: &str, options: Option<UpdateOptions>) -> Result<MemoryResult>

// Update importance score without changing content
pub fn update_importance(&self, id: &str, importance: f32) -> Result<()>

// Delete a trace by ID
pub fn delete_trace(&self, id: &str) -> Result<()>

// Delete all traces matching filters
pub fn delete_all_traces(&self, user_id: &str, agent_id: Option<&str>, run_id: Option<&str>, app_id: Option<&str>) -> Result<u64>

// List traces with optional filters
pub fn list_traces(&self, options: ListOptions) -> Result<Vec<MemoryResult>>

// Get count of traces for a user
pub fn count_traces(&self, user_id: &str) -> Result<usize>

// Get change history for a specific trace
pub fn trace_history(&self, memory_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<HistoryRecord>>

// Batch update multiple traces (skips immutable)
pub fn batch_update_traces(&self, updates: &[(String, String)]) -> Result<Vec<MemoryResult>>

// Batch delete multiple traces (skips immutable)
pub fn batch_delete_traces(&self, ids: &[String]) -> Result<u64>
```

### Search

```rust
// Multi-channel search: vector + BM25 + entity spreading + temporal, fused via RRF
pub fn search(&self, query: &str, options: SearchOptions) -> Result<Vec<MemoryResult>>

// Search with explicit reranker
pub fn search_reranked(&self, query: &str, options: SearchOptions, reranker: &dyn crate::rerank::Reranker, candidate_multiplier: usize) -> Result<Vec<MemoryResult>>

// Rebuild FTS index (call after batch insertions)
pub fn rebuild_fts_index(&self) -> Result<()>
```

### Session / Episode / Compact

```rust
// Primary ingestion: send chat messages to a Session

pub fn compact(&self, session_id: &str) -> Result<CompactResult>

// Create an episode manually

// Search episodes (vector + FTS + entity with RRF fusion)
```

## MemoryConfig — All Fields & Defaults

```rust
pub struct MemoryConfig {
    pub db_path: String,                          // default: "memory.db"
    pub collection_name: String,                  // default: "default"
    pub embedding_dims: usize,                    // default: 384
    pub dedup_threshold: f32,                     // default: 0.15
    pub default_limit: usize,                     // default: 10
    pub custom_fact_extraction_prompt: Option<String>,  // default: None
    pub custom_update_memory_prompt: Option<String>,    // default: None
    pub enable_graph: bool,                       // default: true
    pub graph_spreading_depth: usize,             // default: 2
    pub inclusion_prompt: Option<String>,          // default: None
    pub exclusion_prompt: Option<String>,          // default: None
    pub custom_categories: Option<Vec<(String, String)>>,  // default: None
    pub enable_forgetting_curve: bool,            // default: true
    pub retention_weight: f32,                    // default: 0.7
    pub stability_growth_factor: f32,             // default: 2.5
    pub prune_retention_threshold: f32,           // default: 0.05
    pub max_memories_per_user: Option<usize>,     // default: None
    pub max_db_size_mb: Option<usize>,            // default: None
    pub pruning_strategy: PruningStrategy,        // default: LRU
    pub auto_prune: bool,                         // default: false
    pub power_config: Option<PowerConfig>,         // default: None
    pub extraction_depth: ExtractionDepth,        // default: Standard
    pub embed_batch_size: usize,                  // default: 10
    pub compact_threshold: usize,                 // default: 20
    pub rrf_vector_weight: f64,                   // default: 0.5
    pub rrf_fts_weight: f64,                      // default: 0.3
    pub rrf_entity_weight: f64,                   // default: 0.2
    pub rrf_k: usize,                             // default: 30
    pub rrf_candidate_multiplier: usize,          // default: 3
    pub rrf_temporal_weight: f64,                 // default: 0.15
    pub enable_rerank: bool,                      // default: false
    pub rerank_candidate_multiplier: usize,       // default: 3
}
```

### PowerConfig

```rust
pub struct PowerConfig {
    pub full_power_threshold: f32,    // default: 0.5
    pub power_save_threshold: f32,    // default: 0.2
    pub defer_when_critical: bool,    // defer operations when battery is critical
}
```

### ExtractionDepth

```rust
pub enum ExtractionDepth {
    Standard,   // Single-pass extraction (fast, default)
    Thorough,   // Sliding window + detail pass (slower, more complete)
}
```

### PruningStrategy

```rust
pub enum PruningStrategy {
    LRU,         // Least recently accessed (default)
    Importance,  // Lowest importance first
    Decay,       // Lowest importance after decay
}
```

---

## Session / Episode / Compact / Meditate Flow

The data pipeline follows five layers of increasing abstraction:

```
Stream (raw events)
  -> Session (grouped events within a time window)
    -> Episode (compacted summary with purified events)
      -> Trace (atomic facts extracted from episodes)
        -> Identity (high-level personality traits)
```

### 1. append_events() — Ingest raw data

Send chat messages (or any events) to a Session. Events are stored as-is in the stream layer. Returns `AppendEventsResult` with a `compact_needed` flag when unprocessed events exceed `compact_threshold` (default: 20).

### 2. compact() — Purify and summarize

When called on a session:
1. **Purifies events** via LLM: resolves coreferences ("he" -> "Alex"), grounds temporal references ("yesterday" -> "2026-03-29"), extracts locations.
2. **Embeds purified content** for vector search on events.
3. **Generates Episode summary**: title, summary, significance score (0.0-1.0).
4. **Creates a Narrative trace** (Resolution::Narrative) in the memories table.
5. **Marks events as processed**.

### 3. meditate() — Extract and consolidate

A 4-phase orchestration that loops until all unmeditated episodes are processed:
1. **Decay** — Apply forgetting curve to existing memories (always runs, no LLM needed).
2. **Per-Episode Fact Extraction** — LLM reads each episode independently and extracts atomic, self-contained facts with timestamps.
3. **Store + Vector Dedup** — Extracted facts stored via `add()`. Cosine similarity against existing memories handles dedup automatically (threshold < 0.15 = duplicate). No LLM reconciliation needed — deterministic, no hallucination risk.
4. **Graph + Entity Linking** — Single LLM call extracts entities and relationships. Aho-Corasick automaton links memories ↔ entities for spreading activation.

### 4. get_session_context() — Retrieve for RAG

Returns purified events from a session within a token budget. Useful for providing conversation context to an LLM during retrieval. Prefers purified content when available, falls back to raw content for unprocessed events.

---

## Search Pipeline

```
Query
  |
  +-- Channel 1: Vector Search (cosine similarity on embeddings)
  |     weight: 0.5 (rrf_vector_weight)
  |
  +-- Channel 2: BM25 Full-Text Search (SQLite FTS5)
  |     weight: 0.3 (rrf_fts_weight)
  |     activated when: SearchOptions.keyword_search = true
  |
  +-- Channel 3: Entity Spreading Activation
  |     weight: 0.2 (rrf_entity_weight)
  |     activated when: config.enable_graph = true
  |     process: Aho-Corasick entity extraction (<1ms)
  |              -> graph spreading (configurable depth, default 2 hops)
  |              -> collect all memories linked to expanded entities
  |
  +-- Channel 4: Temporal Search
  |     weight: 0.15 (rrf_temporal_weight)
  |     activated when: query has temporal intent (date references, "when", "ago", etc.)
  |
  v
  RRF Fusion (Reciprocal Rank Fusion, k=30)
  |
  v
  Cross-Encoder Reranking (optional, API or ONNX)
  |
  v
  Forgetting Curve Scoring
  |   final_score = similarity * (retention_weight * retention + (1 - retention_weight) * importance)
  |
  v
  Results (sorted by final score, limited to requested count)
```

---

## Knowledge Graph

### Entity/Relationship Extraction

When `enable_graph` is true and an LLM is available, `add_smart()` and `meditate()` extract entities and relationships:

- **Entities**: Named things (people, places, organizations, concepts) with type labels
- **Relationships**: Directed edges between entities (e.g., Alice --works_at--> Google)
- **Memory-Entity Links**: Automatic Aho-Corasick matching links memories to entities they mention

### Graph Search

`search_graph(query, user_id, depth)` performs:
1. SQL LIKE search for matching entity names
2. Neighborhood traversal (BFS) up to `depth` hops
3. Returns all discovered entities and relationships

### Entity Spreading Activation (Search Channel)

During search, the entity channel:
1. Extracts entity names from the query using Aho-Corasick (<1ms)
2. Expands via graph traversal (configurable depth, default 2 hops)
3. Collects all memories linked to expanded entities
4. Results are fused with other channels via RRF

---

## Quick Start Examples

### Rust

```rust
use std::sync::Arc;
use memme_core::{MemoryConfig, MemoryStore, AddOptions, SearchOptions, ChatMessage};
use memme_embeddings::onnx::OnnxEmbedder;

fn main() -> memme_core::Result<()> {
    // 1. Create store
    let config = MemoryConfig::new("memory.db", 384);
    let embedder = Arc::new(OnnxEmbedder::new()?);
    let store = MemoryStore::new(config, embedder)?;

    // 2. Add memories
    store.add("User prefers dark mode", AddOptions::new("alice"))?;
    store.add("User drinks coffee every morning", AddOptions::new("alice"))?;

    // 3. Search
    let results = store.search("morning routine", SearchOptions::new("alice").limit(5))?;
    for r in &results {
        println!("{} (score: {:.4})", r.content, r.score.unwrap_or(0.0));
    }

    // 4. Session/Episode flow (requires LLM)
    // store.set_llm_provider(llm);
    // let result = store.append_events("session-1", &messages, "alice", None)?;
    // if result.compact_needed { store.compact("session-1")?; }
    // store.meditate(MeditateOptions::new("alice", "app"))?;

    Ok(())
}
```

### Python

```python
from memme import MemoryStore

# Create store. Requires MEMME_VEXDB_LITE_EXTENSION in the environment.
# Build the current version from source (PyPI still serves legacy 0.1.1):
#   pip install maturin && maturin develop --release
store = MemoryStore("memory.db", embedder="mock")

# Owner-global memory is shared across this owner's pets.
store.add("The owner has a severe peanut allergy.", user_id="owner-001")

# Relationship memory belongs to one pet only.
store.add(
    "Momo and the owner first met under the ginkgo tree.",
    user_id="owner-001",
    agent_id="momo",
)

# Search — owner scope + current pet scope, fused.
memories = store.search(
    "What should I remember for Momo's birthday snack?",
    user_id="owner-001",
    agent_id="momo",
    limit=5,
)

# Session/Episode flow (requires an LLM)
# store.set_llm(api_key, base_url, model)
# store.append_events("session-1", messages, "owner-001")
# store.compact("session-1")
# store.meditate("owner-001", "demo")
```

### Node.js

```javascript
// npm install @wjmwjmwb/memme  (macOS / Linux)
// Requires MEMME_VEXDB_LITE_EXTENSION in the environment.
const { MemoryStore } = require("@wjmwjmwb/memme");

// Tests without an embedding service:
const store = MemoryStore.newMock("momo-memory.db");
// Or with an OpenAI-compatible embedding provider:
// const store = MemoryStore.newOpenai(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY, "momo-memory.db");

// Owner-global memory
await store.add("The owner has a severe peanut allergy.", "owner-001");

// Relationship memory, scoped to Momo
await store.add(
  "Momo and the owner first met under the ginkgo tree.",
  "owner-001",
  "momo",
);

const memories = await store.search(
  "What should I remember for Momo's birthday snack?",
  "owner-001",
  "momo",
  null,
  5,
);
console.log(memories);
```

## Configuration Example

```rust
use memme_core::{MemoryConfig, PowerConfig};
use memme_core::types::PruningStrategy;
use memme_core::config::ExtractionDepth;

let config = MemoryConfig {
    db_path: "memory.db".into(),
    collection_name: "default".into(),
    embedding_dims: 384,
    dedup_threshold: 0.15,
    default_limit: 10,
    enable_graph: true,
    graph_spreading_depth: 2,
    enable_forgetting_curve: true,
    retention_weight: 0.7,
    stability_growth_factor: 2.5,
    prune_retention_threshold: 0.05,
    max_memories_per_user: Some(1000),
    pruning_strategy: PruningStrategy::LRU,
    auto_prune: true,
    compact_threshold: 20,
    extraction_depth: ExtractionDepth::Standard,
    // RRF weights
    rrf_vector_weight: 0.5,
    rrf_fts_weight: 0.3,
    rrf_entity_weight: 0.2,
    rrf_temporal_weight: 0.15,
    rrf_k: 30,
    rrf_candidate_multiplier: 3,
    // Reranking
    enable_rerank: false,
    rerank_candidate_multiplier: 3,
    // Prompts
    inclusion_prompt: Some("Extract work-related tasks and deadlines".into()),
    exclusion_prompt: Some("Ignore passwords and secrets".into()),
    // Mobile battery awareness
    power_config: Some(PowerConfig {
        full_power_threshold: 0.5,
        power_save_threshold: 0.2,
        defer_when_critical: true,
    }),
    ..Default::default()
};
```

## Security

- **Memory Immutability** — Mark memories as immutable; storage layer prevents modification/deletion
- **Privacy Levels** — `LocalOnly` (never leaves device), `Syncable`, `EncryptedSync` per-memory; enforced on export
- **Data Expiration (TTL)** — Per-memory TTL with automatic cleanup during meditation
- **Audit Trail** — Every create/update/delete logged in `history` table with timestamp and before/after snapshot
- **Bearer Token Auth** — Optional API key authentication on REST server
- **CORS Protection** — Configurable cross-origin policy on REST server
- **Exclusion Prompts** — Configure LLM to skip extracting sensitive content categories
- **SQL Injection Prevention** — All queries use parameterized `$N` placeholders; collection names validated against alphanumeric whitelist
- **Content Hashing** — Hash-based deduplication and integrity checking
- **Webhook Notifications** — Subscribe to memory lifecycle events (feature-gated)

## Benchmark

PetMemBench — MemMe's product benchmark for AI-pet memory. Scenarios cover
owner safety, per-pet relationships, fresh events, privacy isolation, Chinese
retrieval, expiration, correction, and deletion. Release benchmark for 0.1.2,
2,000 memories, median of three independent runs:

| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Required scenarios | 11 / 11 |
| Extended scenarios | 3 / 3 |
| Recall@10 | 100% |
| Search p50 | 1.999 ms |
| Search p95 | 3.062 ms |
| Search p99 | 17.128 ms |
| Write throughput | 445.7 memories/s |
| SQLite file size | 10.4 MB |

These numbers use deterministic local test embeddings and an x86_64 process
under Rosetta on Apple Silicon. They validate the storage and retrieval
contract, not final reply quality or production performance. Scenarios:
`benchmarks/petmem/scenarios.json`; release report:
`docs/reports/2026-09-01_release-0.1.2.md`.
